subject: Re: Renewal QBR & Roadmap — split demo; ownership transfer for exec/tech slots
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-admin@clearwave.com
Date: 2027-11-14T15:02:00Z
Subject: Renewal QBR — request to split demo and move date

Hi Rafael,

Hope you’re well. We’re in the middle of finalizing our Nov executive calendar and a few conflicts came up. We’d like to move the Renewal QBR currently slated for Nov 18 to a later week and split the demo into two parts:

- Executive-facing 45min roadmap summary (C-suite + product leaders)
- Technical deep-dive (engineers + ops) for the day after

Can your team own both slots or should we split ownership between your AE and a technical lead?

Our preferred weeks: Nov 29–Dec 3 or Dec 6–10. We’ll share a short attendee list once we lock exec availability. Attached current slides for reference.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Director, Product & Partnerships
ClearWave Health

[Attachment: current-qbr-slides.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — request to split demo and move date

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the heads up. Splitting the session makes sense and we can do that. Proposed approach:

1) Exec roadmap (45 min) — Marissa will own facilitation, outcomes, and scheduling logistics (exec-friendly).
2) Tech deep-dive (75–90 min) — Priyom will own the technical run and prerequisites.

Available windows (all US ET):
- Tue Nov 30, 11:00–12:00 (Exec) / Wed Dec 1, 11:00–12:30 (Tech)
- Thu Dec 2, 14:00–14:45 (Exec) / Fri Dec 3, 13:00–14:30 (Tech)

If one of those pairs works, we’ll lock it. I’ve attached an updated agenda draft (QBR_agenda_v2.pdf) and a run-of-show skeleton for Marissa/Priyom to iterate on.

Marissa/Priyom — flag any objections and let me know if you want me to remain the primary contact for ClearWave or to pass the calendar ownership to Marissa for exec and Priyom for tech.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — exec slot ownership

I can take the exec session. Quick asks so we can tailor remarks:

- Final exec attendee list and titles (CISO/CTO/CEO etc) — helps me shape messaging.
- Any corporate slides you want highlighted or removed from the exec summary.
- Recording permission? We usually record exec summaries but will mark sensitive items.

I’ll own invites, calendar entries, and the 45-minute run-of-show. Attaching a one-pager I’ll use as a starting point.

Thanks — looping in Priyom for the tech requirements.

—Marissa
Principal Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: exec-onepager.docx (Docx)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T14:36:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — tech deep-dive prerequisites

Thanks — I’ll run the tech deep-dive. A few items I need from ClearWave before we lock a slot:

- Sandbox access or a short set of example requests (anonymized) so we can run a latency/cost demo.
- Expected audience: engineers or SREs? If SREs will attend, we’ll include an infra/backpressure segment.
- Any compliance questions (data residency, VPC) you want surfaced in the session.

Suggested tech prep call: 30 minutes the week prior to the deep-dive to validate credentials and test knobs (quantization, batching settings). I’ve attached a short prep checklist.

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: tech-prep-checklist.md (Markdown)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: eng-lead@clearwave.com (Michael Chan)
Date: 2027-11-16T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — exec + tech slots confirmed (partial)

Thanks everyone — we’ll take the first pair you suggested:

- Exec: Tue Nov 30, 11:00–11:45 ET (Attendees: CEO Dana Park, VP Product Rajesh Iyer, Head of Compliance Lila Gomez)
- Tech: Wed Dec 1, 11:00–12:30 ET (Eng + Ops)

We’ll send calendar invites from our side and include the attendee list. Priyom — I can share a sanitized data sample and a short service account for the sandbox by Friday EOD.

Attaching our availability block for the week and a single .ics you can reference.

Cheers,
Sarah

[Attachment: availability.ics (Calendar)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T22:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — final schedule and run-of-show

Perfect — locking those times now and I’ll pass calendar ownership to Marissa and Priyom respectively. Quick next steps checklist:

- I’ll send the calendar holds and an invite to the prep call (Priyom + ClearWave engs) for Nov 24.
- Sarah to send the sanitized sample and service account by Nov 19.
- Marissa to review slides and circulate a 1‑page exec deck by Nov 23.
- Priyom to prepare the sandbox demo + run internal pre-flight on Nov 25.

Attached is the finalized run-of-show (runofshow_final.xlsx) and my copy of the updated agenda. If anything shifts, please flag in this thread — otherwise I’ll hand off scheduling and ownership to the respective owners and remain copied for escalation.

Thanks team — looking forward to it.

—Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: runofshow_final.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]
